doc: package-provided cudagraph option? (introspection only, no rebuild)
conclusion: cudagraphs (inductor config triton.cudagraphs / cpp-wrapper cudagraphs) is a COMPILE-TIME option baked into the exported wrapper; it cannot be switched on for an existing package without re-export and re-compile -> NOT done (no rebuild). A load-time, rebuild-free knob exists: aoti_load_package(..., run_single_threaded=True) -> tested as M5.
